item.title: The Marketplace That Pays Before It Sells
item.description: How CAC becomes recoverable only when acquired fashion customers generate retained contribution, repeat behaviour, and marketplace memory.

item.title: Water Scarcity and India's Economic Growth: How Water Availability Constrains Development and GDP Growth
item.description: Data-driven analysis of how agricultural water intensity, groundwater depletion, urban system losses, and drought constrain regional growth in India.

item.title: What Collapsed in Indian EdTech After 2021
item.description: Analysis of how pandemic-era emergency demand exposed the weak unit economics of India's high-cost paid K-12 EdTech model, while digital learning persisted through free and hybrid channels.

item.title: The Chicken-and-Egg Problem
item.description: A quantitative analysis of cold-start dynamics in two-sided marketplaces, using field experiments, academic research, and company filings.
